title: Credit growth to moderate in H2, FY27: Icra
summary: Credit growth is projected to ease to 15-16% for FY27, impacted by hardening policy rates. Fresh slippages for public sector banks are estimated to increase to ₹1 lakh crore in FY27. Private banks may experience fresh slippages amounting to ₹1.3 lakh crore. While banks' asset quality may deteriorate slightly, net interest margins should improve. The overall banking sector faces challenges amid these credit growth expectations and market conditions.

title: India in striking distance of 8% growth as reforms boost economy: Shaktikanta Das
summary: Das said the BFSI sector has a crucial role to play in India's journey from a lower-middle-income economy to a high-income economy, through its intermediation in allocation of financial resources. He said the sector would be required to support India's next-gen Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI), be the frontline of green and transition finance and become the catalyst for democratising financial inclusion to support this journey.

title: Credit card additions hit second-highest monthly level in 2026 as banks gear up for festive season
summary: HDFC Bank and Axis Bank together accounted for nearly 43% of the net additions during September, adding 539,878 cards between them. The two private sector lenders emerged as the largest contributors to fresh additions, followed by SBI Cards.

title: India's growth momentum stays resilient despite global headwinds: RBI Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta
summary: Reserve Bank Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta indicated that India's real GDP growth fell short due to external shocks. She highlighted that India has managed over 7 percent growth despite challenging circumstances in recent years. Additionally, Gupta expressed confidence that improved global conditions could enhance growth by another percentage point. She discussed the importance of diversifying economic activities to mitigate risks and emphasized that food security remains stable amid El Nino.
